line: Crowley attributes Cups to Water. The Ace names no letter for the suit; the letter Mem for Water comes from the general account and from the Hanged Man.

sections.title: Water and the feminine
sections.line: Crowley calls the Ace of Cups the complement of the Ace of Wands, and gives Water to the suit.

quotes.quote: “Wands”, attributed to Fire; “Cups”, to Water; “Swords”, to Air;
It is the feminine complement of the Ace of Wands, and is derived from the Yoni and the Moon

sections.title: The Holy Grail and Binah
sections.line: The Ace is, in Crowley's words, the essential form of the Holy Grail, with lotuses on the sea of Binah.

quotes.quote: This accordingly represents the essential form of the Holy Grail.

sections.title: The letter of Water
sections.line: No letter is given for the suit. Crowley's general account names Shin, Mem and Aleph for the Fire, Water and Air series, and the Hanged Man states Mem for Water.

quotes.quote: These elements are represented in the Hebrew alphabet by the letters Shin, Mem and Aleph.
This card, attributed to the letter Mem, represents the element of Water.
